% Figures: at most 0.62 of the text height, so that figure and legend fit one page; a figure
% file that has not been built yet prints a placeholder box instead of

\let\erlincludegraphics\includegraphics
\renewcommand{\includegraphics}[2][]{\IfFileExists{#2}{\erlincludegraphics[#1,height=0.62\textheight,keepaspectratio]{#2}}%
  {\fbox{\parbox[c][4cm][c]{0.9\linewidth}{\centering Figure file not built yet:\\\texttt{\detokenize{#2}}}}}}

% The audit-summary figure is erl_fig_audit, the ERL version of the
% earlier audit figure (sections/erl_fig_audit.tex). It is placed right after the second figure of
% figure_captions_erl.tex (the shoreline map), so that the main figures keep their intended order.
% Remove this hook if the audit summary is added to figure_captions_erl.tex.
\newif\iferlauditdone
\newcommand{\erlauditafter}{2}
\AfterEndEnvironment{figure}{\ifnum\value{figure}=\erlauditafter\relax\iferlauditdone\else
